timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Why do we need XDR when we already have separate Defender products?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Because attacks span domains. XDR correlates endpoint, email, identity, and cloud signals into one picture.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So what's the big deal about cross-domain correlation?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: A phishing email plus suspicious endpoint activity plus unusual cloud access. Together, it's a breach.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What about Automated Investigation and Response?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: AIR triages alerts, collects evidence, and remediates threats automatically. Analysts focus on what matters.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Can I query the data myself?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Advanced hunting lets you write KQL queries across all Defender data. Full visibility, full control.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Dramatically. Related alerts collapse into one incident. Instead of 200 alerts, you see 5 meaningful ones.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How does it compare to just using Sentinel alone?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Sentinel is your SIEM for external data. XDR is deep Defender integration. Together, they're unstoppable.
